'''Zoiya Relle''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] who ranked among the best fighters in an empire created by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]. To compensate for her lack of charisma and guile, Relle created a [[Relle Talisman|Sith talisman]] that allowed its wielder to dominate the [[Brain/Legends|minds]] of other individuals.<ref name="FDCR" />

The Sith Lady subsequently became one of the few women to ever rule the Sith.<ref name="FDCR" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] is set between [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] becoming a hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively.</ref> it was believed that a [[Unidentified Sith (Relle Talisman)|Sith]] carrying the Relle Talisman had perished on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], a world with significant historical ties to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the ideological antithesis of the Sith tradition.<ref name="FDCR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zoiya Relle was introduced in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|core rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="FDCR" />
